newsitem.title: USA: Calif '96 construction volume rose 5.9 pct -report.
newsitem.headline: Calif '96 construction volume rose 5.9 pct -report.

text.p: California's construction volume totaled $32 billion in 1996, up 5.9 percent from 1995, according to a report released Monday.

The Construction Industry Research Board said the non-residential building total of $9.52 billion for 1996 was up more than $120 million from the board's projection. Adjusted for inflation, it was the largest total since 1991, up 16.7 percent from 1995.

The board said it expected an increase of 12.3 percent in total construction to $35.93 billion in 1997. For 1998, the Construction Industry Research Board said construction should increase an additional 6.8 percent to $38.38 billion.
